input.quote: 22.14 Solicitation. Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
input.rationale: Section 22.14 is the only solicitation restriction in the Agreement and it binds Customer as well as Vendor. It is mutual, but it reaches all employees of the other party (not just personnel directly involved in the Services), runs for the entire multi-year Term rather than 12 months from the end of a person's involvement, and has no carve-out for general advertisements or unsolicited approaches. Covering all personnel for the whole Term fails the fallback on material terms and approaches walk-away, so we narrow it with the minimum edits needed to reach the fallback (scope, duration in numerals, carve-outs); the restriction remains solicitation-only and does not prohibit hiring.

mappings.quote: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.

proposal.summary: Narrow mutual non-solicit to involved personnel, 12 months post-involvement, with advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We narrowed this mutual non-solicit to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, and added carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches; as drafted it barred solicitation of all employees for the whole Term, which is outside our position.
